def transform(g):
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    # Grid lines are the rows/columns dominated by the separator color.
    line_color = max(set(v for row in g for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in g))
    rs = [i for i,row in enumerate(g) if sum(v == line_color for v in row) >= w * 0.45]
    cs = [j for j in range(w) if sum(g[i][j] == line_color for i in range(h)) >= h * 0.45]
    # If separator lines are not the globally most common color, derive line coordinates
    # from regular row/column patterns of the dominant separator color.
    out=[]
    for a,b in zip(rs,rs[1:]):
        row=[]
        for c,d in zip(cs,cs[1:]):
            corners=[g[a][c],g[a][d],g[b][c],g[b][d]]
            interior=g[(a+b)//2][(c+d)//2]
            row.append(corners[0] if corners.count(corners[0])==4 else interior)
        out.append(row)
    return out
